safe_content_feature_requests.title: Onboarding Tutorial Prompt System
safe_content_feature_requests.player_value: Helps first-time players immediately understand initial movement and combat mechanics without guessing.
safe_content_feature_requests.rationale: First-time players need clear introductory cues when stepping onto their first route.
safe_content_feature_requests.desired_outcome: Display clear, non-intrusive instructional text overlays or narrative hints during the first few steps of the Moss Trail.

safe_content_feature_requests.title: Route Discovery Ledger and Collection Milestones UI
safe_content_feature_requests.player_value: Allows collectors to track completion percentages, unique items found per route, and unlock milestone cosmetic rewards.
safe_content_feature_requests.rationale: Currently, completing routes like Gloomwood Hollow gives coins, but lacks a centralized interface to showcase collection progress and encourage re-playing routes.
safe_content_feature_requests.desired_outcome: An accessible in-game UI ledger displaying route completion tallies, collected unique items (like Gloomcaps or Moon Sigils), and reward milestones.

safe_content_feature_requests.title: Route-Specific Secret Chambers and Lore Collectibles
safe_content_feature_requests.player_value: Gives players strong narrative and exploratory incentives to revisit routes multiple times.
safe_content_feature_requests.rationale: As an explorer, once a route is finished, there are few gameplay reasons to replay it other than grinding standard currency.
safe_content_feature_requests.desired_outcome: Add optional secret branch paths or lore fragments into existing routes (such as Ember Forge or Gloomwood Hollow) that reward players with unique thematic cosmetics or codex entries upon discovery.

safe_content_feature_requests.title: Elite Combat Waves & Aggressive Enemy AI Profiles
safe_content_feature_requests.player_value: Provides high-tier players with genuine mechanical mastery tests, satisfying demands for intense risk/reward encounters.
safe_content_feature_requests.rationale: Current high-difficulty routes rely primarily on environmental hazards rather than engaging, high-density combat pressure.
safe_content_feature_requests.desired_outcome: Introduce tougher elite enemy compositions and dynamic combat waves specifically for difficulty 3 routes like Frostfang Pass and Whispering Fen.

safe_content_feature_requests.title: Daily Route Bounties for Bonus Currency
safe_content_feature_requests.player_value: Gives players a structured, predictable way to earn extra coins toward high-cost marketplace cosmetics.
safe_content_feature_requests.rationale: Helps bridge the gap between mid-tier cosmetics and elite items without breaking overall baseline game balance.
safe_content_feature_requests.desired_outcome: Players can check a daily bounty board for rotating route objectives that award bonus coins upon completion.

all_feature_requests.title: Input Buffering and Movement State Validation
all_feature_requests.player_value: Prevents accidental damage and repetitive frustrating inputs when players encounter navigation blocks.
all_feature_requests.rationale: Edge-case analysis confirms that players can spam walk commands into static barriers, taking multiple ticks of avoidable damage.
all_feature_requests.desired_outcome: Engine-level input validation that suppresses invalid walk actions against active hazards or buffers jump transitions.

observations.evidence: Play trace begins immediately with walking actions ('walk' from step 0 to 1) with no introductory tooltips, tutorial prompts, or UI guidance for a first-time session.
observations.recommendation: Add welcome tooltips or an introductory prompt at step 0 to explain movement and combat mechanics.

observations.evidence: Moss Trail successfully served as an accessible starting route with clear progression up to step 12 completion.
observations.recommendation: Keep Moss Trail as the default recommended starting route for new players.

observations.evidence: Completed Gloomwood Hollow route and received standard coin payout, but found no in-game ledger or tracking for collected items like Gloomcaps or Root Relics.
observations.recommendation: Prioritize the Route Discovery Ledger and Collection Milestones UI backlog item to give collectors a visual tracker for route completions and rare drops.

observations.evidence: Successfully purchased and equipped the 'trail_cap' cosmetic for 45 coins, leaving 88 coins in the wallet.
observations.recommendation: Introduce more diverse cosmetic categories (e.g., trails, capes, auras) and route-specific outfit drops to increase long-term collection incentives.

observations.evidence: Gloomwood Hollow features collectibles like 'Gloomcap' and 'Root Relic', but gameplay trace shows standard walking/jumping/combat without interactive collection events for these unique items.
observations.recommendation: Add distinct interactive collection nodes or hidden side paths within routes to make gathering thematic items more rewarding for explorers.

observations.evidence: In Frostfang Pass (Difficulty 3), only 2 combat encounters occurred across 12 steps (Slime at step 2, Kobold at step 11), with long stretches of uninterrupted walking and jumping.
observations.recommendation: Increase enemy spawn density and introduce mini-boss or elite variant encounters on difficulty 3+ routes to align with the Combat Challenger persona goals.

observations.evidence: Encountered standard basic enemies (Slime and Kobold) on Frostfang Pass, which features 'ice spikes' hazards but lacks distinct enemy mechanics tied to the freezing theme.
observations.recommendation: Integrate theme-specific status effects or attack patterns for enemies found in high-difficulty environmental hazards.

observations.evidence: Completing a full Treasure Run route yielded 30 coins total, yet elite cosmetics like the Waypoint Crown sit behind a price point requiring multiple consecutive route completions or specific marketplace incentives.
observations.recommendation: Adjust mid-tier route base coin rewards or introduce minor milestone bonuses to smooth out the currency curve leading up to elite items.

observations.evidence: The player purchased two items sequentially (Trail Cap for 45 and Moon Hood for 80), ending with 21 coins and receiving a 'Not enough coins' message when attempting the Waypoint Crown.
observations.recommendation: Provide a wishlist or 'coins needed' delta indicator in the marketplace interface when a player attempts to buy an unaffordable item.

observations.evidence: Backlog item noted: 'High-Contrast UI Theme & Focus States' mentions marketplace navigation and UI elements need clearer keyboard focus rings.
observations.recommendation: Prioritize adding visible keyboard focus outlines and high-contrast color options for menus and marketplace navigation.

observations.evidence: Marketplace purchase flow successfully completed and updated coin balance (126 coins left after 45 coin purchase).
observations.recommendation: Keep the immediate confirmation feedback on cosmetic purchases.

observations.evidence: Telemetry shows two consecutive 'obstacle_hit' events at step 2 because walk inputs were accepted against a known active hazard without automatic input buffering or state prevention.
observations.recommendation: Implement movement command validation and obstacle input buffering to prevent redundant walk commands when blocked by hazards.
